parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number for a paged query. The default value is 1.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the content. Valid values:

- **zh** (default): Chinese.

- **en**: English.

parameters.name: MemberUid
parameters.description: The UID of the member account.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page.

parameters.name: TransitRouterType
parameters.description:
The type of the CEN transit router. Valid values:

**Basic**: Basic Edition

**Enterprise**: Enterprise Edition
